---
name: Format request
about: Ask for a new file type to be supported, or better depth for an existing one
title: "[Format] "
labels: format
assignees: ''
---

**Which format**
Name and extension(s), e.g. "Foo CAD project (.foo)".

**What it is**
A one-line description and, if you have them, links to the format spec or docs.

**What you would want to see**
Just identification? Metadata readout? A full viewer? Whatever would be useful.

**Sample file**
If you can, attach a small, non-sensitive sample. This is the single most
helpful thing - most formats are added by studying a real example's bytes.

**Anything else**
Existing tools that read it, quirks, variants, etc.
